say:0:1821427001:1.text: There is no mistaking it. These are the remains of Marl, the first mate.
say:0:1821427001:1.source_cn: 毫无疑问，这是大副马普尔的尸体。

say:1:1821427002:1.text: A coarse rope has cut deep into his neck, holding his body against the mast. Marl was hanged—a grim, old-fashioned execution.
say:1:1821427002:1.source_cn: 一段粗糙的绳索深深嵌入他的脖颈，将他牢牢固定在桅杆上。...

say:2:1821427003:1.text: Just like Bentley, Marl died clutching a finely crafted key.
say:2:1821427003:1.source_cn: 与班特里一样，你从马普尔紧攥的指骨中发现了另一把做工精...
say:2:1821427003:1.male: Just like Bentley, Marl died clutching a finely crafted key.
say:2:1821427003:1.female: Just like Bentley, Marl died clutching a finely crafted key.
